risks.title: Risque cybersécurité
risks.score_rationale: As a major financial institution handling sensitive customer data and transaction systems, cybersecurity represents the highest risk category. Financial services are prime targets for sophisticated cyber attacks with potential for significant operational disruption and regulatory penalties. Citation: "Credit continues to perform well, consistent with our aggregate moderate-to-low risk appetite". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is a critical risk for the organization due to vulnerability of IT systems and sensitive customer data to increasingly sophisticated threats

risks.title: Risque de crédit
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is elevated due to exposure to potential loan losses, nonperforming assets, and economic downturn impacts. Large loan portfolio across multiple geographies and customer segments creates material exposure. Citation: "Credit continues to perform well, consistent with our aggregate moderate-to-low risk appetite". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Credit risk is a major concern due to exposure to loan losses and nonperforming assets, particularly in stressed economic environments

risks.title: Risque réglementaire
risks.score_rationale: As a systemically important financial institution, Huntington faces extensive regulatory oversight with frequent regulatory changes affecting capital requirements, stress testing, and compliance obligations. Citation: "Credit continues to perform well, consistent with our aggregate moderate-to-low risk appetite". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory risk is significant due to frequent changes in financial and banking regulations, capital requirements, and compliance obligations

risks.title: Risque de liquidité
risks.score_rationale: Moderate liquidity risk exists due to dependence on financial markets for funding and asset-liability management challenges, particularly in volatile rate environments. Citation: "Credit continues to perform well, consistent with our aggregate moderate-to-low risk appetite". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Liquidity risk is a material concern due to dependence on financial markets for funding and potential deposit volatility

risks.title: Risque de concurrence
risks.score_rationale: Regional banking market faces intense competition from larger national banks, fintech companies, and community banks. Margin compression and customer acquisition challenges persist. Citation: "Our 2025 results reflect strong growth across loans, deposits, and value-added fee services, supported by". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competition risk is significant due to presence of numerous competitors in banking and financial services markets

risks.title: Risque de réputation
risks.score_rationale: As a public financial institution, reputational damage from operational failures, compliance breaches, or market downturns could affect customer confidence and capital markets access. Citation: "Credit continues to perform well, consistent with our aggregate moderate-to-low risk appetite". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reputation risk is important due to sensitivity of banking institution reputation to negative events and market perceptions

company_description: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated operates as the bank holding company for The Huntington National Bank that provides commercial, consumer, and mortgage banking services. It offers financial products and services to consumer and business customers, including deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, dealer financing, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services. The company also provides 24-Hour Grace, Asterisk-Free Checking, Money Scout, $50 Safety Zone, Standby Cash, Early Pay, Instant Access, Savings Goal Getter, And Huntington Heads Up; digitally powered consumer and business financial solutions to consumer finance, regional banking, branch banking, and wealth management customers; direct and indirect consumer loans; dealer finance loans and deposits; and private banking, wealth management and legacy planning through investment and portfolio management, fiduciary administration and trust, institutional custody, and full-service retail brokerage investment services. In addition, it offers equipment financing, asset-based lending, distribution finance, structured lending, municipal financing solutions, and Huntington ChoicePa

risks_rationale_fr.0: Institution financière majeure manipulant données clients sensibles. La cyber est la catégorie de risque la plus élevée : disruption opérationnelle et pénalités réglementaires significatives. Citation: "of material risks that could adversely affect Huntington s business, financial condition, results of oper".
risks_rationale_fr.1: Risque de crédit élevé du fait des pertes potentielles, actifs non performants et impacts de ralentissement économique. Portefeuille large sur multiples géographies et segments. Citation: "negatively affected by credit risk exposures, which could adversely affect our net income and capital".
risks_rationale_fr.2: En tant qu'institution financière systémiquement importante, Huntington fait face à une supervision étendue avec évolutions fréquentes touchant capital, stress tests et conformité. Citation: "Weakness in economic conditions could adversely affect our business".
risks_rationale_fr.3: Risque de liquidité modéré du fait de la dépendance aux marchés pour le financement et des défis de gestion actif-passif, notamment en environnement de taux volatil. Citation: "rating could adversely affect our access to capital and could increase our cost of funds".
risks_rationale_fr.4: Marché bancaire régional fait face à concurrence intense des grandes banques nationales, fintechs et banques communautaires. Compression des marges et défis d'acquisition. Citation: "any of which could adversely affect our business or reputation, and create significant legal an".
risks_rationale_fr.5: Institution financière publique, atteinte réputationnelle par défaillances opérationnelles, manquements conformité ou ralentissements pourrait affecter la confiance et l'accès au capital. Citation: "change manifesting as physical or transition risks could adversely affect our operations, businesses, and customers".

fr.risks: Les principaux risques incluent la sensibilité aux cycles économiques, la concurrence accrue des banques nationales et des fintechs, ainsi que la dépendance aux régulations fédérales et étatiques qui peuvent affecter les marges de crédit et les exigences de capital.
